findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.phishunt.io" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain, list_brand_phishings, search_phishings, analyze_url · Private data: analyze_url, analyze_url_deep · Public sink: get_campaigns.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain, list_brand_phishings, search_phishings, analyze_url · Private data: analyze_url, analyze_url_deep · Public sink: get_campaigns

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
